literal: Hold on to the hold of him who is free from attachment; that hold, hold on to, in order to let go of attachment.
translation: Cling to the hold of the one who has no attachments. Cling to that hold in order to let go of your own attachments.
modern: எந்தப் பற்றும் இல்லாதவனுடைய பற்றினைப் பற்றிக் கொள்ளுங்கள். உங்களுடைய மற்ற பற்றுகளை விடுவதற்காகவே அந்தப் பற்றினைப் பற்றிக் கொள்ளுங்கள்.
explanation: This couplet plays brilliantly on the word 'paṟṟu', which means both the physical act of holding on and the psychological state of attachment. It advises the seeker of renunciation to attach themselves to the one who is completely free of attachments. By holding firmly to this single, pure connection, all other worldly ties and desires can be successfully severed. The paradox of using an attachment to destroy attachments highlights the practical method of achieving true detachment.
